title: Unknown zone or place is answered with the whole district, with no warning
what_happens: Asking for zone 99 or Atlantis returns 15,115 incidents, District-wide, no caveat or chip.
what_should_happen: Say the zone or place was not found, or ask which one; never show district totals as if they answered.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-askiq.test.ts -t askiq-1; or POST /api/collector/assistant/chat
class: confident answer about the wrong thing
skeptic_why: Reproduced on fresh server 3191: zone 99 and Atlantis both return all incidents (15,019 now, clock is live) with scope line saying District-wide. The scope line does show District-wide, so it is not hidden, but nothing says the place was not found. Severity lowered P0 to P1 (label is truthful, no wrong number). Evidence tests/qa/pass4/skeptic-askiq.test.ts

title: A date in 2030 or a period of 0 days is silently answered as the last 90 days

what_should_happen: Say the period is not valid or has no data.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-askiq.test.ts -t askiq-2; or POST /api/collector/assistant/chat
class: confident answer about the wrong thing
skeptic_why: Reproduced: 2030 and last 0 days both answered as Last 90 days (Adyar 685 for last 0 days, same as no period). The scope line names 90 days, so it is disclosed but never says the asked period was rejected. Severity lowered P0 to P1. The test regex (not last 90 days) is crude but the behaviour is real.
